BackendCallGroup.description_en: Initiates a voice group call to multiple phone numbers. The content of the group call is that of approved templates. You can log on to the VMS console and choose Voice Call Template to view the template ID. This feature enqueues the phone numbers to be called. The time when the phone numbers are called is uncertain
BackendCallGroup.description_zh: 向指定的一批号码发起语音群呼。群呼内容为已经通过审核的模板。可以通过登录国际语音控制台，进入“模板管理”查看模板ID。此功能会将号码送入发送队列进行排队。实际呼出时间不确定

BackendCallSignal.description_en: Sends a voice verification code and voice notification with variables to a phone number
BackendCallSignal.description_zh: 向指定号码发送语音验证码和带参数变量的语音通知

GroupCall.description_en: Initiates multiple voice calls to specified numbers. Supports voice file templates or text-to-speech templates for the calls
GroupCall.description_zh: 向指定号码发送多次语音呼叫，支持语音文件模板或文本转语音模板进行呼叫

SignalCall.description_en: Sends a voice verification code or a voice notification with parameter variables to a specified phone number. Voice file templates and text-to-speech templates are supported
SignalCall.description_zh: 向指定号码发送语音验证码和带参数变量的语音通知，支持语音文件模板或文本转语音模板

VoiceGroupCall.description_en: Sends a voice notification to multiple phone numbers. A voice file or text-to-speech (TTS) template is supported
VoiceGroupCall.description_zh: 向指定号码发送多次语音呼叫，支持语音文件模板或文本转语音模板进行呼叫

VoiceSingleCall.description_en: Sends a voice verification code or voice notification with variables to a phone number. A voice file or text-to-speech (TTS) template is supported
VoiceSingleCall.description_zh: 向指定号码发送语音验证码和带参数变量的语音通知，支持语音文件模板或文本转语音模板
